Name: C. elegans whole-brain neuroPAL and immobilized calcium imaging
Description: All of the datasets here contain neuroPAL whole-brain structural images. A subset of these files also contain unstimulated calcium imaging data from the worm immobilized in a micro fluidic chip. Each dataset has ~30-50% of neuron centers labeled with cell IDs.
